# Evidence: the audit log

Every agent step, human approval, sign-in, export, and safety action is appended to [`output/audit_log.json`](../output/audit_log.json). Each entry stores the hash of the one before it, so editing or deleting any entry breaks the chain. This file is the log from building and testing the app locally (2026-10-13 to 2026-10-20); the live site keeps its own.

*Generated by `scripts/build_evidence.py` on 2026-10-26. The log was only read.*

## Integrity check

- Entries: **456**
- Hash chain intact: **yes**
